verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents selfie liveness, government ID verification, accounts that group a user's history, and linking inquiries by a caller-supplied reference ID. None of it describes automatically detecting the same face or document reappearing under different names. Reference-ID linking is a user-side arrangement, and workflow tagging of high-risk inquiries is an adjacent feature, so neither counts as duplicate-identity detection.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, the platform detects repeat and duplicate identities across verifications — the same face or document resurfacing under different names is flagged automatically
